- (unary).name: negation
- (unary).plain: - a is the negation of a.

⋀.name: logic and
⋀.plain: a ⋀ b is true exactly when both a and b are true.

⋁.name: logic or
⋁.plain: a ⋁ b is true exactly when a or b is true.

¬.name: logic not
¬.plain: ¬ a is true exactly when a is false.

→.name: logic implies
→.plain: a → b is false exactly when a is true and b is false.

≢.name: logic xor
≢.plain: a ≢ b is true exactly when a and b differ.

⇔.name: logic equal
⇔.plain: a ⇔ b is true exactly when a and b have the same truth value.
